Slate rail — World identity. Cutoff means chart boundary, not destruction. Crossings are bridges; only markers are joins.

g.text: Deterministic, self-consistent timeline: no branch is created by the tesseract.
Time travel is a signal-to-the-past (gravity data), not body travel between worlds.
THE MESSAGE WAS ALWAYS SENT — bootstrap causality observed, not forked (genealogy=bootstrap_cycles).
Time dilation alters elapsed time but does not fork a universe.
Declared merge count: 0. A count supplies no merge locations; none are invented.
